svg.title: Doublet center wiring guide
svg.desc: Front views of both center variants with exact default hole positions. Solid wire is on the front face; dashed wire is behind the plate. Left and right colors are separate electrical sides.

g.text: Front = the face toward you; terminal hardware mounts on this face.
Each radiator continues into the feedline

svg.text: 1 front → back · 2 back → front · 3 front → back
Join matching colors on each stud; keep tails slack.
Tug each conductor: the weave should take the load while the inner tails remain relaxed.
Routes are schematic; plate outlines and hole positions match the default models.
